subject.title: fix(models): make nested modelPolicy wildcards match by segment boundary

question: Should existing malformed or legacy `modelPolicy.allow` entries be made invalid immediately, or should this PR include a supported Doctor migration/recovery path before that validation becomes mandatory?
rationale: The new validation changes the upgrade contract, while ambiguous legacy values cannot safely be rewritten without deciding how much automatic repair is acceptable.

options.title: Add Doctor recovery before strict validation
options.body: Keep the canonical matcher, add a non-destructive `openclaw doctor --fix` migration or actionable recovery flow, and prove both fresh and upgraded configurations.

options.title: Defer strict validation
options.body: Land nested-wildcard matching without rejecting legacy entries until maintainers define a safe migration policy.

options.title: Accept immediate rejection
options.body: Deliberately require operators to repair old entries manually and document that breaking upgrade behavior as a release decision.

recommendation.title: Add Doctor recovery before strict validation
recommendation.body: Keep the canonical matcher, add a non-destructive `openclaw doctor --fix` migration or actionable recovery flow, and prove both fresh and upgraded configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed model-policy contract change and can clarify the intended upgrade semantics.
